change: R3 - Gate 2 keeps seeing parent-level conditions
added: buildConditionSuspicionInput(compilerInput) - the anchor's operative text plus the PARENT_SCOPE excerpts already present in the context bundle.
whyRequired: Gate 2 is the only gate that can PERMIT a review skip; Gate 1 can only force review. The red baseline measured 15 of the 67 dual-key CONMED candidates carrying condition language that exists ONLY in their parent chapeau - after R1 an unmodified Gate 2 would stop seeing it and could report NO_MATERIAL_CONDITION_SUSPECTED for a candidate whose governing condition simply lives one level up.
separationProven: The reconciliation's source side is still buildSourceInventory(compilerInput.operativeSourceText, ...) - unchanged. Gate 2's reading window widened; the candidate's operative source did not. A test asserts both halves on the same input: the builder sees a parent amount, and compilerInput.operativeSourceText does not contain it.
behaviourWhenNoParentScope: returns compilerInput.operativeSourceText unchanged; an absent contextBundle is tolerated.
